transfer_router_vs_rq1_router.note: first = RQ2 transfer router (never saw the benchmark), second = RQ1 router (trained on its train questions); the targets' test-split questions only; paired bootstrap over duplicate groups, decisions fixed

ranking_vs_cutoff.note: hindsight = the cutoff the section 6 rule would choose on the set's own outcomes; it uses the outcomes being scored, so it is a diagnostic and never the router's result

seen_vs_unseen_subjects.note: first = A2 router (never saw these subjects), second = A router (trained with them); test-split questions of the held-out subjects; paired bootstrap over duplicate groups

primary.description: RQ2 primary: the frozen transfer router on code at the 3-point target level, next to the same router on its source-pool reference
